gcm.purpose: Expose the existing durable Prospect CRM Next Action operation from the relationship workspace.
changeNotes: Loads a Prospects-only Set Next Action enhancement through the established shared page-enhancement architecture.
Replaces only the current dated CRM Next Action without creating relationship activity, changing Prospect stage, or recording a proposal.
Adds a regression gate that locks the versioned loader and the set_next_action-only write boundary.
